rawContent:
It's not justice, when women are regarded as liars.

It's not consent, when women are afraid to say no. 

It's not free speach, when women are silenced. 

It's not human rights, when women are unprotected. 

It's not rocket science, why women have had enough. 

#MeToo

Today, I would like to send my support to Sofie Linde, who has started a new #MeToo debate in Denmark. 

On TV, she told her story of sexual harassment by a powerful media boss who demanded oralsex. She was just 18.

Now 701 women in the media have signed a letter of support ✊

@Feministfest Sofie Linde is amazing. She has been under attack since she spoke out. We never had much of a #MeToo Movement in Denmark. Mainly, because the media has been extremely hostile from the beginning - now we can all see why.

@2point5_boxer @Kirstineholst @LotteRod Hvis modige kvinder ikke havde navngivet Weinstein var der aldrig blevet lagt mærke til #MeToo. Det må altid være op til den enkelte kvinde om hun vil nævne navnet på sin krænker. Det er hendes beslutning og hun har min respekt uanset hvad.
